_comment: The issue #137 sweep corpus, pinned. run_sweep.py converts each package with rypip (which resolves the pinned version from PyPI into its cache), builds the generated crate, and records the rustc error histogram. Keep this list small and meaningful: each package adds a full convert+build to every sweep.

packages.name: urllib3
packages.note: The historical #137 corpus. Round 55: the bool-and-boxed-value fold fix and the urllib.parse calls (~1086 rustc errors). Round 56: flat (1085).

packages.name: certifi
packages.note: Close to a fully-clean package (was ~8 errors); a clean package is a far better regression canary than a 1600-error crate.

packages.name: idna
packages.note: Round 56: the new tuple->PyValue From impls cut the boxed-tuple E0277 wall from 957 to 157.

packages.name: requests
packages.note: The dependent-package frontier (imports urllib3/charset_normalizer/idna/certifi; 112 errors at the round-54 baseline). Round 55: urllib.parse surface + class registry (69). Round 56: unannotated class defaults, quoted annotations, builtin-class value positions, compat self-alias imports, tuple boxing, del-read loop targets, range annotations (29).
